$meta.note: These are real, named businesses. They replace the invented names currently in src/lib/data/seed/eateries.ts ('Bamboo Hut Garden Cafe', 'Valley Organic Bistro', 'Royal Kangla Kitchen' and the rest are not real places).
$meta.ratings: google_rating / tripadvisor_rating are as aggregated by wanderlog on 2026-09-23. Ratings drift — re-pull before launch, and do not present them as Yening's own ratings.
$meta.status_warning: Several entries are marked closed. The Imphal F&B scene turned over heavily after 2023. EVERY record here must be phone-verified before it goes on a live platform.
$meta.price_range: 1 = budget, 2 = mid, 3 = upper — inferred from descriptions, not from published menus. Verify.
$meta.coordinates: null throughout. Plus Codes are given where the source had them (e.g. 'RW4M+H25' resolves against Imphal) — geocode from those rather than guessing.

unverified_do_not_publish.reason: travelsetu.com is a programmatically generated travel-content site. These three names, and the dishes attributed to them, appear nowhere else. Treat as probably fabricated until confirmed on the ground.

gaps: No verified eatery data collected for Churachandpur/Lamka, Senapati, Tamenglong, Thoubal, Kakching, Moreh, Jiribam or Bishnupur/Moirang. The district .nic.in accommodation pages list 'fooding & lodging' hotels (see stays.json) but no standalone eateries.
No opening hours for almost any record — Google Maps or a phone call is the only way to get these.
No menu prices. 'Cost for two' figures circulating on listicles are unsourced.
